title: SystemRequest
description:
Evaluation request payload representing a Jev-compatible System 1 judgment query.

See <https://docs.typesafe.ai/api#request-body> for the canonical wire specification.

model.description:
Required. `"jev-latest"` or a registered model alias.
We keep this required even though Phase 0 doesn't dispatch — the
engine layer in Phase 2 will use it to pick a backend.

questions.description:
Required. Map of user-chosen id → typed question. Keys are NOT sent
to the model and are NOT used in inference (per spec).

ChoiceQuestion.description: Pick one option from a set. Spec: <https://docs.typesafe.ai/api#choice>

criteria.description:
Map of option key → rubric description. **Values may be `null`**
("use null when an option needs no extra detail").

instructions.description: Instructions describing what categorical decision is requested.

NoulCriteria.description:
Reserved `true`/`false` keys. `r#true` / `r#false` because those are
keywords in Rust (and in the JSON spec).

NoulQuestion.description:
Yes/no question. Returns the probability the answer is yes.

Spec: <https://docs.typesafe.ai/api#noul>

criteria.description:
Optional descriptions of what a yes and a no mean.
Reserved keys: `true`, `false`.

instructions.description:
Instructions describing what judgment is requested.
Can be a string, object, or array.

Question.description: Tagged union of the three question kinds. The `type` field is the discriminant.

oneOf.description: Boolean probability evaluation (yes/no), returning a single probability value.
Categorical choice evaluation across discrete options.
Ordinal rating evaluation rated along an ordered rubric of at least 2 levels.

ScoreQuestion.description: Rate along an ordered rubric. Spec: <https://docs.typesafe.ai/api#score>

criteria.description: Ordered array of level descriptions. Must contain at least 2.

instructions.description: Instructions describing what ordinal score is requested.

State.description: State to evaluate. Permissive JSON shape: any string, object, or array.
